_meta.scope: Destination registry: currency, import tax (VAT/GST/sales tax) standard rate and base, official tariff lookup, and how far our duty data goes. Tier 'verified' = checked against real declarations; 'official' = loaded from the national schedule; 'indicative' = standard import tax only, duty % entered by the user (or from WITS/TRAINS when loaded).
_meta.tax_base_note: cif_plus_duty = tax on CIF + customs duty (+ excise where any). Most VAT/GST countries. Exceptions noted per country.

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.tax_note: Sales tax 10% standard (5% on some foods/goods, 0% exempt) on CIF + duty + excise

countries.name: Singapore
countries.tax_note: GST 9% on CIF + duties; almost all goods duty-free except liquor, tobacco, fuel, vehicles

countries.name: Indonesia
countries.tax_note: VAT (PPN) effectively 11% on most imports (12% statutory applied to 11/12 base from 2025) on CIF + duty; plus PPh 22 income tax prepayment 2.5–10% for importers
countries.extra_note: PPh 22 (2.5% with API licence, 7.5–10% without) is a prepaid income tax, not a cost for most registered importers.

countries.name: Thailand
countries.tax_note: VAT 7% on CIF + duty + excise

countries.name: Vietnam
countries.tax_note: VAT 10% standard (8% reduced rate extended through 2026 for most goods except some categories) on CIF + duty + special consumption tax

countries.name: Philippines
countries.tax_note: VAT 12% on CIF + duty + excise + other charges

countries.name: Brunei
countries.tax_note: No VAT/GST; import duty only (most goods 0–5%)

countries.name: Cambodia
countries.tax_note: VAT 10% on CIF + duty + special tax

countries.name: Laos
countries.tax_note: VAT 10% on CIF + duty + excise

countries.name: Myanmar
countries.tax_note: Commercial tax 5% on CIF + duty

countries.name: Australia
countries.tax_note: GST 10% on customs value + duty + transport/insurance; most MFN duty 0–5%

countries.name: New Zealand
countries.tax_note: GST 15% on CIF + duty

countries.name: United States
countries.tax_note: No federal VAT or sales tax at import; MFN duty plus additional tariffs by origin (Section 301/232, reciprocal tariffs) — check the HTS and current executive orders; MPF 0.3464% and HMF 0.125% apply

countries.name: Brazil
countries.tax_note: Layered: II (duty), IPI (0–30%), PIS/COFINS 11.75%, ICMS 17–20% by state, each on a grossed-up base — the 17% here is a rough stand-in; treat Brazil results as order-of-magnitude only
